_comment: Bundled default scope/owner overrides. User overrides live in ~/.aither/vault-scope.json (written by `adk vault scope` and the panel's re-file control). Shape: {"SECRET_NAME": {"scope": "mine|workspace|tenant|provider|platform|host", "owner": "optional"}}. The lockbox falls back to name-based heuristics for anything not listed. Secrets are NEVER renamed — this only changes how they are grouped.
